PersistentHeader.title: Overview
PersistentHeader.updatingOverlayDescription: Fetching fresh data for the current selection.

OverviewHighlights.title: Overview
OverviewHighlights.subtitle: Summary of key performance indicators
OverviewHighlights.recentActivityHint: Shows how many assistant queries were made each day. Every user message is recorded as an event. Useful for spotting usage trends.

activityTrend.title: Activity trend
activityTrend.hint: Compares total events (queries) with unique active users per day. If events grow faster than users, each user is making more queries.

roleDistribution.title: Role distribution
roleDistribution.hint: Shows how active users are distributed by role in the organization. Useful to understand which groups use the assistant the most.

hourlyPattern.title: Hourly pattern
hourlyPattern.hint: Highlights the busiest hours of the day. Useful for maintenance planning and detecting usage peaks that can impact performance.

RAGQualityMetrics.title: RAG quality and performance
RAGQualityMetrics.subtitle: Response times, token usage, and system health

responseTimeTrend.title: Response time trend
responseTimeTrend.hint: Shows how LLM response time and RAG retrieval time evolve over time. High values can indicate performance issues.
responseTimeTrend.description: LLM and RAG latency by day (ms)

tokenUsage.title: Token usage
tokenUsage.hint: Compares input tokens (user content + context) versus output tokens (generated response) for LLM and RAG. More tokens mean higher cost and processing time.

systemHealth.title: System health
systemHealth.hint: Monitors server resource consumption. Sustained high CPU, RAM, or GPU usage may indicate that infrastructure scaling is needed.

InsightsView.title: Query analysis
InsightsView.subtitle: Most frequent words and topics in user searches
InsightsView.noData: No search data available for this period

topWords.title: Top searched words
topWords.hint: Shows the keywords users mention most often in their queries. Helps identify high-interest topics and potential knowledge gaps.

filters.ariaLabel: Filter top searched words by language
filters.empty: No top searched words found for {language}
filters.error: Failed to load top searched words. Please try again.

topTopics.title: Most frequent topics
topTopics.hint: Groups queries by detected topic. Helps understand which knowledge areas are consulted most and where to prioritize content improvements.

filters.error: Failed to load top topics. Please try again.

sources.title: Sources
sources.descriptionAdmin: Connect the sources you want to include in the shared RAG corpus. Once they are ready, start indexing so the backend refreshes the vector store.
sources.descriptionUser: Connect your sources and choose which ones should be available in your chats. These connections do not start or modify the shared indexing process.
sources.notConfigured: This provider is not configured on the backend yet.
sources.googleDriveHelp: The browser starts Google OAuth, then the returned authorization code is sent to the backend and stored there.
sources.readyToChatTitle: Start indexing when your sources are ready
sources.readyToChatDescription: When you finish connecting sources, enable VDB so the backend starts indexing the connected content.

vdb.title: VDB indexing
vdb.description: Keep VDB disabled while you connect or refresh sources. Enable it when you want the backend to start indexing.
vdb.activeDescription: The backend is indexing connected sources. Stop VDB before connecting or refreshing providers.
vdb.inactiveDescription: Indexing is off. You can connect or refresh sources now.
vdb.connectPrerequisite: Stop VDB indexing before connecting or refreshing providers.
vdb.startRequiresSelection: Select at least one connected source for chat retrieval before starting indexing.

sources.selectForChat: Use this source for chat retrieval
sources.stepsDescriptionAdmin: Follow this sequence whenever you prepare new sources for the shared corpus.
sources.stepsDescriptionUser: Follow this sequence to enable a source in your chat experience.

steps.startAdmin: Leave VDB indexing off while you prepare your sources.
steps.startUser: Connect only the sources you want available in your conversations.
steps.connect: Connect the providers you want to include, such as Google Drive.
steps.authorize: Sign in to each provider and approve the requested access.
steps.finishAdmin: When you are done, enable VDB so the backend starts indexing the connected content.
steps.finishUser: Select the source so your chat can use it during RAG retrieval.
